name: Data & AI
intro: Engineers, scientists and analysts who build with AI and turn your data into reports and tools your team actually uses.

roleDetails.text: Builds AI features and agents into your product and workflows, and connects models to your data and tools.
Trains, tests and deploys machine learning models, and keeps them running and accurate in production.
Digs into your data to answer business questions, builds models and forecasts, and explains what the numbers mean.
Builds and maintains the pipelines and warehouse that move your data from source systems to where it gets used.
Pulls and cleans data, builds reports and dashboards, and answers day-to-day questions about the business.
Designs, tunes and maintains your databases, and keeps them backed up, secure and fast.
Builds the dashboards and reporting in tools like Power BI, Tableau or Looker that leadership checks every week.
Automates repetitive work with AI and workflow tools, and writes and tests the prompts behind it.
